title: People
subtitle: Administrators and employees in your organization.
loadError: Unable to load your organization's members.
noAccess: You do not have permission to view people.

invite.title: Invite an employee
invite.emailSentNotice: An invitation email has been sent to {{email}}. This link and code are also shown here once, as a backup.
invite.emailNotSentNotice: The invitation email could not be sent automatically. Share this link with the employee directly instead - it is shown only once.

detail.title: Member
detail.permissionsHint: Bold entries are individually overridden for this person; everything else follows their role's default bundle.
detail.devicesHint: Devices this person has attempted to clock in from appear here once device binding enforcement (a later work package) is live.
detail.kioskPinHint: Set or reset this employee's kiosk identification PIN.
detail.kioskPinError: Unable to set this employee's PIN.
detail.leaveEntitlementHint: Override this employee's annual leave days for this year - e.g. legally-required increases for long tenure (10+ years of social insurance entitles 30 days, not the default 21).
detail.leaveEntitlementError: Unable to update this employee's leave entitlement.
detail.deactivateHint: Revoke this employee's access to the application entirely. Their historical data is kept - this is reversible.
detail.deactivateWarning: This employee will no longer be able to sign in to PROSM Time. Their historical attendance data is kept, and this can be reversed later.
detail.removeHint: Permanently remove this employee from PROSM Time - their account, attendance history and every related record are deleted, and this cannot be undone. Blocked while a retention hold applies, they are currently clocked in, or they reviewed/approved records for other employees (deactivate instead in that case).
detail.removeWarning: This permanently deletes this employee's account and all of their data. They will never be able to sign in again, and this cannot be reversed.
detail.dataRightsHint: Delete this employee's personal attendance data on request.
detail.deleteDataWarning: This permanently deletes this employee's attendance sessions, presence/location history, exceptions, corrections, breaks, evidence, notifications and device bindings. It is blocked while a retention hold applies (e.g. an approved timesheet) or while they are currently clocked in.
detail.deleteDataError: Unable to delete this employee's data.

attendance.title: Attendance (on behalf)
attendance.hint: Perform Clock In/Out for this employee when they are unable to do it themselves. This is recorded as a distinct administrative action, never merged into their own attendance history.
attendance.noAssignedSites: This employee is not assigned to any site yet.
attendance.notClockedIn: This employee is not currently clocked in.
attendance.clockInError: Unable to clock in this employee.
attendance.clockOutError: Unable to clock out this employee.
attendance.actorSubjectNotice: Performed by {{actor}} on behalf of {{subject}}. Recorded with your identity as the actor, {{subject}} as the subject, and the reason below.

onBehalf.title: Clock In/Out On Behalf
onBehalf.subtitle: Record attendance for an employee who can't do it themselves right now.
